snippet.title: Madorica real estate english trailer
snippet.description:
An addicting game for Nintendo Switch that combines a video game with pen and paper!
GIFT TEN INDUSTRY.K.K. has developed VR cooperative-style board games such Mask of Anubis, Mask of Moai, and other board games that fuse digital and analog play. Now, they have brought that concept to Nintendo Switch with a puzzle game that uses pen and paper!
